tunables.name: OPEN
tunables.reason: browser API constant WebSocket.OPEN (1): not a number we choose

tunables.name: MINUTES_PER_DAY
tunables.reason: a unit fact (24 h x 60 min = 1440 minutes in a day), not a tuning: nobody tunes how long a day is in minutes; the game day's real length is the gameDayMinutes row (Lead 2026-10-18)

branchIds.reason: the asset family name in a ground-look row (`asset: "loot"` = loot.glb's node, else a path): a schema category the loader validates, not a content id

the page's prompt rule 'the bank is the Exchange's' compares the zone it stands in with the town zone id; the page cannot import origins/presence/zones.ts (it loads the presence registry and server frame), whose town-zones.json row carries `trade: true` for the same zone; the page's own zone rows (frontier plan) do not flag it. OWED: a `trade` flag on the page's zone rows

the saved View setting's value (localStorage 'origins-preview.view.v1' is 'first' or 'third'): a two-value setting the page itself writes, a closed vocabulary of the ☰ menu's View toggle, not a content id (Auditor 2026-10-18)
